You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",

 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline":"The pelacarsen Phase 3 Lp(a)HORIZON trial failed to meet its primary cardiovascular endpoint, consistent with an underpowered design expecting only a 12.3% relative risk reduction (HR 0.877) at 54.1% power.","summary":"The trial randomized 8,323 patients with established cardiovascular disease and Lp(a) ≥70 mg/dL to pelacarsen or placebo, targeting 993 primary endpoint events. The top-line readout states the trial did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing cardiovascular events. The calculator predicted narrow success with an expected HR of 0.877 (12.3% RRR) and only 54.1% power, below the conventional 80% threshold; the minimum detectable HR at 80% power was 0.837. Phase 2 data showed -67% Lp(a) reduction and -19% LDL-C reduction, but no verified phase 3 on-treatment Lp(a) reduction was reported. Strong genetic evidence supports Lp(a) causality (Open Targets score 0.922; variant ORs 1.38-3.67), so failure most likely reflects an effect too small to detect rather than lack of target validity.","key_evidence":["8,323 patients randomized (Readout text supplied by the user;
